en.search.title: Find the code that already works.
en.search.subtitle: Source-backed search over your local XERJ indexes. No account. No paid API.

en.search.idle: Run a search to see referenced passages
en.search.empty: Connect a local XERJ index and search to display matches.

en.chat.subtitle: Ollama generates answers locally using the retrieved search results as optional context.
en.hardware.title: Your hardware, your AI.
en.hardware.subtitle: Detect basic system resources, see installed Ollama models and optionally download one.
en.hardware.hint: Requires installed Ollama and Internet access. Downloads may be several GB.
en.hardware.note: RAM-only suggestion, not a performance guarantee; GPU VRAM not evaluated.
en.hardware.pullConfirm: Download {model} using Ollama? This requires Internet access and disk space.
en.hardware.pullStarted: Download started. Refresh the installed models to check completion.
en.about.title: Built to complement XERJ.
en.about.subtitle: Independent Apache-2.0 prototype by @pilahito. This is not an official XERJ product.
en.about.body: Designed as an optional companion interface that leaves the original XERJ engine untouched.
